name: Iodine V1 (Lafleur 2026)
description: Kuratierte Iod-Basisdatenbank Version 1, basierend auf Lafleur et al., J. Phys. D 59, 023001 (2026). Core-Set: 6 Spezies, 12 Reaktionen. Ratenkoeffizienten aus Tabellen 13/14 des Reviews (Fits an Ambalampitiya et al. 2021 Cross-Sections). Status: Review-basiert, nicht vollstaendig validiert.

species.name: I- (ground)
species._note: Electron affinity 3.059 eV. Negative ion wall flux = 0 (electropositive sheath assumption).

_rate_fit_documentation.format_eq33: K(Te) = A * [ln(1 + B*Te + C*Te^2)]^D * exp(-E/Te), Te in eV, K in m^3/s
_rate_fit_documentation.format_eq34: K(Te) = A * exp(-B/Te + C/Te^2 - D/Te^3 + E/Te^4) * Te^(-F), Te in eV, K in m^3/s
_rate_fit_documentation.cross_section_basis: Ambalampitiya et al. (2021) BSR calculations + Esteves (2022) extrapolations

reactions.name: e + I2 -> I2+ + 2e (Ionisation)
reactions._source: Table 13, Lafleur 2026. Threshold: 9.31 eV (Cockett et al. 1996).

reactions.name: e + I2 -> I+ + I + 2e (Diss. Ionisation)
reactions._source: Table 13. Threshold ~11.63 eV (measured: 11.63 +/- 0.05 eV). Branching: 10% of total iz (Ambalampitiya 2021).

reactions.name: e + I2 -> 2I + e (Dissoziation)
reactions._source: Table 13. Threshold: 1.542 eV (dissociation limit). Only Hamilton (2015) data available. Limited to >10 eV; extrapolated at high energies.

reactions.name: e + I2 -> I- + I (Diss. Attachment)
reactions._source: Table 13. SIGNIFICANT UNCERTAINTY (17%). Data highly variable across sources (Fig.21). Ambalampitiya 2021 used.

reactions.name: e + I -> I+ + 2e (Ionisation)
reactions._source: Table 13. Threshold 10.451 eV. Factor-of-2 spread in cross-sections below 30 eV (Fig.14).

reactions.name: e + I -> I* + e (Lumped excitation, 4 levels)
reactions._source: Table 13 K_exc1,I (lowest lumped level, Table 6). Threshold 0.9426 eV = I(2P1/2) state. Review notes this single process underestimates energy loss; higher lumped levels important at Te>5 eV.

reactions.name: e + I2 -> I2* -> I2 + hv (Anregung, relaxiert)
reactions._source: Relaxing fraction of I2 electronic excitation. eta_prediss=0.5: 50% relax back to I2.

reactions.name: e + I2 -> I2* -> 2I + e (Anregung -> Praedissoziation)

rate._note: eta_prediss * K_exc,I2. eta_prediss = 0.5. Physically: excited I2* above dissociation limit predissociates.

reactions._source: Predissociating fraction of I2 electronic excitation. 3Pi_u (repulsive, eta~1.0), 1Pi_u (bound, eta~0.3), averaged eta=0.5. Ref: Lafleur 2026 Sec.3.3.3, Ambalampitiya 2021 Fig.7.

reactions.name: e + I2 -> e + I2 (Elastisch, MTCS)
reactions._source: Table 14 K_elm,I2 (momentum transfer). NOTE: MTCS data uncertain - factor ~5 discrepancy between Ambalampitiya and Yadav (Fig.18).

reactions.name: e + I -> e + I (Elastisch, total)
reactions._source: Table 14 K_el,I (total elastic). NO MTCS DATA EXISTS for atomic I (review p.14). Using total elastic as proxy. Significant discrepancy below 3 eV between calculations (Fig.13).

reactions.name: I+ + I- -> 2I (Ion-Ion Rekombination)

rate._note: Eq.26: K = 5e-14 * sqrt(300/Tg). Using 300K value as constant. Tg-dependent form recommended for future.

reactions._source: Eq.26, Lafleur 2026. Based on Greaves (2020) measurements and chlorine analogy. Earlier Yeung/Grondein values (9.3e-15) considered too low.

reactions.name: I2+ + I- -> I + I2 (Ion-Ion Rekombination)

rate._note: Eq.26: Same rate as I+ + I-. Products: atom + molecule (confirmed by DESIREE experiments, Poline 2023).

reactions._source: Eq.26, Lafleur 2026. Reaction products confirmed by DESIREE facility measurements.

reactions.name: I (wall) -> 0.5 I2 (Surface Recombination)
reactions._source: gamma = 0.02 used by Grondein 2016 (Table II). Review Sec.4 discusses values from 0.005 to 0.44 depending on material. 0.02 is conservative baseline.
